subject.title: fix(sessions_send): omit misleading delivery.status from async A2A responses (#96020)

question: Should normal async `sessions_send` A2A responses omit `delivery` metadata, or should OpenClaw expose explicit status values for those paths?
rationale: Two open PRs fix the same stale pending-status bug with different user-visible response contracts, and automation cannot choose that compatibility policy for maintainers.

options.title: Adopt omission contract
options.body: Land this direction after real OpenClaw proof shows async delivery is omitted and skipped-A2A still reports `skipped`.

options.title: Prefer explicit statuses
options.body: Use the sibling status-based direction only if maintainers define those statuses as observable admission or reply states and update proof/docs accordingly.

options.title: Keep pending contract for now
options.body: Pause or close both fixes if downstream compatibility with `delivery.status="pending"` matters more than removing the misleading field immediately.

recommendation.title: Adopt omission contract
recommendation.body: Land this direction after real OpenClaw proof shows async delivery is omitted and skipped-A2A still reports `skipped`.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest sampled sessions_send delivery-semantics history for this response-contract choice.
